CustomObject.description:
The DriveVehicle Type Sync PostCommit Event is a platform event created to sync Drive Vehicle Type data only after the transaction is fully committed to the database. This helps maintain data consistency and avoids issues where records might not be available immediately due to asynchronous processing.
This event acts as a post-commit alternative to the existing Future Call Event, ensuring a more reliable execution without the constraints of future methods or transaction boundaries.
CustomObject.label: DriveVehicle Type Sync Event
